commandResults.summary: This Learn05 artifact is written by the in-process fixture. The external dotnet test exit code and pass/fail status are recorded by the executor TRX/log, not self-authored here.

tracks.limitation: Narrow public adaptive loader only. The test-owned deterministic fixture is an adaptive overlay checkpoint without a PromptToTaskMachine manifest, so this does not prove PromptToTaskMachine.LoadCheckpointAsync or Translate.

Fresh-load proves loadability and public machine invocation for the test-owned deterministic fixture only. It does not prove semantic quality, held-out/source-disjoint behavior, ablation, rollback, or promotion readiness.

Narrow public correction-adaptive loader only. The test-owned deterministic fixture is not a full SkillSelectionMachine checkpoint/manifest, so this does not prove SkillSelectionMachine.LoadCheckpointAsync or DecideFromTrainedState.

whatThisProves: The OrchestrationReasoning test-owned deterministic fixture using the LEARN-04 pattern id/schema fresh-loads through OrchestrationReasoningMachine.LoadCheckpointAsync and produces a Plan response through OrchestrationReasoningMachine.Plan.
The PromptToTask test-owned deterministic adaptive fixture loads through the public PromptToTaskAdaptiveTrainer.LoadCheckpoint adaptive boundary only.
The SkillSelection test-owned deterministic correction fixture loads through the public SkillSelectionCorrectionAdaptiveTrainer.LoadCheckpoint adaptive boundary only.

The source checkpoint files are generated under a unique test temp root, reported only as <test-temp-root>/... paths, and removed before tracked Learn05 artifacts can record temp_fixture_removed=true.
whatThisDoesNotProve: This does not prove semantic quality.
This does not prove held-out/source-disjoint quality.
This does not prove ablation/no-memorization controls.
This does not prove rollback safety.
This does not promote target checkpoints.
This does not exercise the real LEARN-04 target checkpoint files; it exercises test-owned deterministic fixtures matching the LEARN-04 pattern id/schema.

PromptToTask and SkillSelection are not full machine fresh-load proofs because these test-owned deterministic fixtures are adaptive overlay checkpoints without the full machine checkpoint/manifest shape.
